name: singlet_disease_clinical_gwas_celltype_enrichment
title: GWAS cell-type enrichment
description: Tests which annotated cell types carry more GWAS heritability or polygenic signal for each trait than expected by chance, writing a per-trait enrichment table. The default method, ldsc_seg, fits stratified LD score regression on cell-type specific gene annotations, conditional on a baseline; scdrs aggregates matched-control disease scores per cell type. Requires cell-type labels, per-trait summary statistics and an LD reference matching the GWAS ancestry. Does not write cell-level scores; use the cell-level scoring task for single-cell disease scores, and dry_run first to estimate cost.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

traits.description: GWAS summary-statistic handles, one per trait, such as uns/gwas/<trait>/sumstats.

method.description: ldsc_seg: stratified LD score regression (default). scdrs: per-cell-type aggregation of matched-control disease scores.

cell_type_key.description: obs column with cell-type labels used to build annotations and group cells.

ld_reference.description: LD reference panel handle, such as uns/ld_reference/<panel>; its population must match the GWAS.

ldsc_seg.description: Options for stratified LD score regression; ignored when method is scdrs.

annotation_window_kb.description: Cis window added around each specifically expressed gene when building annotations.

scdrs.description: Options for matched-control scoring; ignored when method is ldsc_seg.

n_ctrl.description: Matched control gene sets per trait; sets the smallest resolvable Monte Carlo p-value.

ctrl_match_key.description: Gene statistic for matching controls; mean_var matches on mean and variance.

n_genebin.description: Number of bins for matching when the matching statistic is continuous.

weight_opt.description: Gene weighting for the raw score; vs weights by inverse root technical variance.

calibration.description: Statistics options shared by both methods.

min_gene_set_size.description: Smallest cell-type gene set kept; scDRS documentation reports reasonable behaviour from 10 genes.

fdr_method.description: Multiple-testing adjustment across cell types within each trait.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for scDRS control draws; ignored by ldsc_seg.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/celltype_enrichment/<trait>/table. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Per trait: method, n_cell_types, n_fdr_0.05 and the top five cell types with enrichment or z, p and fdr. Never raw tables.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
